checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals audience-and-bidding, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals 'audience-and-bidding' and the description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: The target (CPA, ROAS, or as the brief sets it) comes from the brief and is never assumed.
checks.rule: Body confirms the target from the brief and instructs stop-and-ask when it is missing; it states the target is never assumed.

checks.description: Audience layers (prospecting, retargeting, lookalikes) are defined per channel and each maps to a segment and funnel stage.
checks.rule: Body defines prospecting, retargeting, and lookalike layers per channel and maps each to a segment from the strategy-artifact and a funnel stage.

checks.description: The bid strategy per channel is chosen to chase the brief target, with rationale.
checks.rule: Body sets a bid strategy per channel chosen to chase the brief target and states the rationale.

checks.description: The optimization event aligns to the conversion-path events and is never an event the tracking plan does not fire.
checks.rule: Body aligns the optimization event to the conversion-path events (submit or confirm) and forbids optimizing toward an event the tracking plan does not fire.

checks.description: Audiences never derive from personal or sensitive data exposed in a URL parameter.
checks.rule: Body states audiences never derive from personal or sensitive data exposed in a URL parameter.

checks.description: The plan never spends or launches; spend is gated at the human gate.
checks.rule: Body states the plan never spends and never launches, and spend is authorized only at the human gate.

checks.description: No invented target, offer, price, audience the data cannot support, Skill Path title, or instructor name.
checks.rule: Body forbids inventing targets, offers, prices, and unsupported audiences, records unsupported audiences as open items, and bars accreditation and roadmap leaks.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no U+2014 em dash, no U+0640 tatweel, and no Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).
